methodology: 1) Regex audit of all quantumbio_moe source for non-local http(s) URLs. 2) apply_airgap_config must set HF_HUB_OFFLINE / TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE in-process. 3) Live netstat sampling during engine startup + inference looking for outbound (non-localhost) TCP connections. Note: Docker / Postgres / Redis / Qdrant are absent in this environment; infra auto-connect falls back to in-memory stores, all targets are localhost.

live_watch.during_s: startup + generation (~45s window sampled from +3s after launch)
